name: Something's Amiss in the Library
source:
Leaf enrolls in a self-directed learning institution, trying to find direction and meaning. But the academy has more lurking in its shadows than may initially meet the eye!

[From [url=https://iridescentapril.itch.io/somethings-amiss-in-the-library-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Leaf進入一所自主學習機構就讀，試圖找到人生方向與意義。但這所學院的陰影之中，潛藏著遠超表面所見的東西！

[來源：[url=https://iridescentapril.itch.io/somethings-amiss-in-the-library-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
